purpose: Isolate MSP S2 and onboard LEDs before adding pump activation
expected_behavior: Green LED2 indicates ready. One debounced S2/P1.1 press produces six red LED1/P1.0 flashes over about three seconds, then OFF. Holding does not repeat.
pump_pin: P1.6 input with pull-down; never driven HIGH

user_observation.note: S3 is reset. A reset clears press/edge history, so zero counters after that reset cannot establish that S2 was ignored.

direct_red_led_check.scope: Debugger register write/read with CPU halted; this is not an analog pin-voltage measurement or proof of a damaged GPIO.

next_step: Obtain physical LED observation and inspect the board/LED1 path before further firmware changes. After the LED-only check works, add the user's requested three-second pump-and-blink step.
